etf._btcPerShareNote: Taken from the live arkb.openexa.com build. Corroborated to 0.07% by ARKB mid / BTC spot, and by the same check on IBIT (0.00056631 implied vs 0.000567 documented). The old 0.000303 was stale by ~950 bps and produced a phantom CREATE signal. Do NOT recompute this from mid/spot - that forces NAV = mid and zeroes the basis.

market._btcSpotUsdNote: Dry-run seed only; the live feed overrides it. Kept near spot so --dry-run produces realistic ARKB levels instead of an $85k fantasy.

costs._creationRedemptionFeeNote: NOT PUBLICLY DISCLOSED. Exhibit E of AP Agreement is private. PARAMETERS.md estimates $100-$300; the live arkb.openexa.com build uses $500 and that is the figure adopted here. It dominates the cost model (~47 of ~52.5 bps), so revisit it before trusting any signal.
